instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language
topic: Articles: a, an, the, and the Zero Article

questions.question: I have ___ big news. Which choice is correct, and why?
options: no article, it is uncountable
a, it is countable singular
the, it was mentioned before
an, it starts with a vowel
options_en: no article, it is uncountable
a, it is countable singular
the, it was mentioned before
an, it starts with a vowel
questions.explanation: News is an uncountable noun, so it takes no article when it is used in a general sense.
questions.explanation_ar: news اسم غير معدود، فلا يأخذ أداة عند الاستخدام العام.

questions.question: I got ___ job that I told you about. Which choice, and why?
options: no article, it is uncountable
the, the clause identifies it
a, it is a first mention
an, the noun starts with a vowel
options_en: no article, it is uncountable
the, the clause identifies it
a, it is a first mention
an, the noun starts with a vowel
questions.explanation: The relative clause identifies exactly which job, so the noun becomes definite and takes the.
questions.explanation_ar: جملة الوصل تحدد الوظيفة بدقة، فيصبح الاسم معرفاً ويأخذ the.

questions.question: You know that ___ housing market is tough. Which choice, and why?
options: an, it begins with a vowel
no article, it is general
the, the market is unique
a, it is a first mention
options_en: an, it begins with a vowel
no article, it is general
the, the market is unique
a, it is a first mention
questions.explanation: The housing market is a single well-known thing, so it behaves like a unique noun.
questions.explanation_ar: سوق الإسكان شيء وحيد معروف، فيعامل معاملة الاسم الفريد ويأخذ the.

questions.question: There is already ___ couple who are interested. Which choice, and why?
options: the, it was named earlier
an, the noun starts with a vowel
no article, it is plural
a, it is a first mention
options_en: the, it was named earlier
an, the noun starts with a vowel
no article, it is plural
a, it is a first mention
questions.explanation: This is the first time the couple is mentioned, and couple is a singular countable noun.
questions.explanation_ar: هذه أول مرة يُذكر فيها الزوجان، و couple اسم معدود مفرد.

questions.question: ___ potential buyers are coming in two weeks. Which choice, and why?
options: The, the same couple was named
A, it is a first mention here
An, it starts with a vowel sound
no article, they are all general
options_en: The, the same couple was named
A, it is a first mention here
An, it starts with a vowel sound
no article, they are all general
questions.explanation: These are the same buyers already introduced, so the definite article is required.
questions.explanation_ar: هؤلاء هم المشترون أنفسهم الذين ذُكروا قبلاً، فالأداة المعرفة واجبة.

questions.question: I also bought ___ awesome dining table. Which choice, and why?
options: no article, it is uncountable
an, a first mention with a vowel
a, a first mention with a consonant
the, it was named before this
options_en: no article, it is uncountable
an, a first mention with a vowel
a, a first mention with a consonant
the, it was named before this
questions.explanation: It is a first mention and awesome begins with a vowel sound, so an is used.
questions.explanation_ar: إنها أول ذكر، وكلمة awesome تبدأ بصوت متحرك، فنستخدم an.

questions.question: and plant ___ flowers. Which choice is correct?
options: a, it is a first mention
an, it starts with a vowel
no article, general plural
the, they are unique
options_en: a, it is a first mention
an, it starts with a vowel
no article, general plural
the, they are unique
questions.explanation: Flowers here means flowers in general, and general plurals take no article.
questions.explanation_ar: flowers هنا تعني زهوراً بشكل عام، والجمع العام لا يأخذ أداة.

questions.question: when ___ buyers are looking at houses. Which choice is correct?
options: the, these exact buyers here
a, a single buyer here now
an, one unknown buyer here
no article, buyers in general
options_en: the, these exact buyers here
a, a single buyer here now
an, one unknown buyer here
no article, buyers in general
questions.explanation: The sentence describes buyers in general rather than a particular group, so no article is used.
questions.explanation_ar: الجملة تصف مشترين بشكل عام لا مجموعة محددة، فلا تُستخدم أداة.

questions.question: It is worth all ___ effort. Which choice, and why?
options: the, the effort is the known one
a, it is a first mention here
an, it starts with a vowel sound
no article, it is uncountable
options_en: the, the effort is the known one
a, it is a first mention here
an, it starts with a vowel sound
no article, it is uncountable
questions.explanation: The effort refers to the specific work already described, so it is definite.
questions.explanation_ar: effort تشير إلى الجهد نفسه الذي تحدثنا عنه، فهو معرف.

questions.question: where I can find ___ good hardware store. Which choice is correct?
options: no article, it is plural
a, one unspecified store here
the, the only store in town
an, the noun starts with a vowel
options_en: no article, it is plural
a, one unspecified store here
the, the only store in town
an, the noun starts with a vowel
questions.explanation: The speaker means any one suitable store, not a particular known one, so a is used.
questions.explanation_ar: المتحدث يعني أي متجر مناسب غير محدد، لا متجراً معروفاً بعينه، فيأتي a.

questions.question: probably in ___ soft blue colour. Which choice is correct?
options: an, the noun starts with a vowel
no article, it is uncountable
a, one unspecified colour here
the, a colour named before
options_en: an, the noun starts with a vowel
no article, it is uncountable
a, one unspecified colour here
the, a colour named before
questions.explanation: One of many possible colours is meant and it is a first mention, so the indefinite article is used.
questions.explanation_ar: المقصود لون واحد من ألوان كثيرة، وهو أول ذكر، فتُستخدم الأداة النكرة.

questions.question: when ___ weather is nice. Which choice, and why?
options: a, it is a first mention
an, it starts with a vowel
no article, it is plural
the, the weather is unique
options_en: a, it is a first mention
an, it starts with a vowel
no article, it is plural
the, the weather is unique
questions.explanation: Weather is treated as a unique natural thing, so the definite article is normal.
questions.explanation_ar: الطقس يعامل كشيء طبيعي وحيد، فالأداة المعرفة هي الطبيعية.
